## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py` covering the multi-cycle loop logic.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: multi-cycle loop dispatches reviewer agents until PASS / DISPATCH_ARBITER / SHORT_CIRCUIT.

## Loop ordering (canonical — both T3 and T4 must agree)

The loop uses the **reviewer-first** ordering per T4 pseudocode:
1. (Pre-loop) call `next_action(ledger, max_cycles, [], commit_sha, artifacts_dir)` once. If returns SHORT_CIRCUIT, read sidecar and exit.
2. (Loop body, per iteration) dispatch reviewer → compute tuples → `append_cycle` → call `next_action(ledger, max_cycles, findings, commit_sha, artifacts_dir)` → branch on action.

## Specific failing test method names

1. `test_loop_dispatches_three_cycles_then_pass` — mock `next_action` to return DISPATCH_NEXT (after cycles 1, 2) then PASS (after cycle 3). Assert reviewer dispatched 3 times; `append_cycle` called 3 times; exit 0.
2. `test_loop_returns_pass_after_one_cycle_with_no_findings` — first reviewer dispatch returns 0 findings; subsequent `next_action(findings=[])` returns PASS. Assert reviewer dispatched 1 time; `append_cycle` called 1 time; exit 0. (Renamed from `test_loop_exits_immediately_on_pass_cycle_1` to reflect canonical reviewer-first ordering.)
3. `test_loop_breaks_on_dispatch_arbiter_at_max_cycles` — mock `next_action` to return DISPATCH_NEXT after cycles 1-3, then DISPATCH_ARBITER after cycle 4. Assert reviewer dispatched 4 times; arbiter-dispatch hook invoked once (delegation to T6 wiring).
4. `test_loop_short_circuits_pre_loop_with_prior_arbiter` — ledger has same-SHA entry + arbiter-rulings.json present (SHORT_CIRCUIT condition satisfied). Mock pre-loop `next_action(findings=[])` returns SHORT_CIRCUIT. Assert reviewer dispatched 0 times; exit code matches prior BLOCK presence.
5. `test_loop_atomic_ledger_append_per_cycle` — after each reviewer call, `append_cycle` is called with `(cycle_num, tuples, commit_sha, findings_hash)`; verify each call's cycle_num matches iteration counter.

## Behavioral assertions

Mock `cycle_dispatcher.next_action`, the reviewer-dispatch helper (`_dispatch_local_reviewer` — T4 pins this to call `dso_ci_review.dispatch.dispatch_review`), `cycle_ledger.append_cycle`. Assert OBSERVABLE outcomes (call counts, exit codes, ledger entry sequence).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 5 test methods defined with names above
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py -q --co | grep -c 'test_loop_'   # expect 5
- [ ] All 5 tests fail (loop not yet implemented)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(FAILED|ERROR)' | wc -l   # expect ≥ 5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py (new, ~210 lines)
